subject: Geopolitics
title: Platform Regulation
description: A quick win: understand Platform Regulation.

hook.text: The EU fined Meta $1.3 billion for data practices. The US debates Section 230.

buildup.text: Platforms argue they're neutral hosts. Governments argue they amplify harm.

discovery.text: The EU's Digital Services Act requires platforms to remove illegal content and disclose algorithms.

twist.text: Authoritarian states use 'regulation' as cover for censorship. The same law that curbs hate speech can silence dissent.

climax.text: Platform regulation walks a tightrope: too little enables manipulation, too much enables censorship.

punchline.text: Regulate too little and lies win. Regulate too much and truth loses.

quiz.question: Why is platform regulation difficult to get right?
options: All platforms are based in one country
Too little enables manipulation while too much enables censorship
Users prefer no regulation of any kind
